statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-126347 (GHSA-5cjw-f85j-cv6r): Tornado's RedirectHandler open-redirect check misses paths with three or more leading slashes, which browsers follow as a protocol-relative redirect. Tornado 6.6.0 and earlier are affected, and it is fixed in Tornado 6.6.1 by commit c503241622c0efe7c40110d89834ce8b7fead1e4: https://github.com/tornadoweb/tornado/security/advisories/GHSA-5cjw-f85j-cv6r, https://github.com/tornadoweb/tornado/commit/c503241622c0efe7c40110d89834ce8b7fead1e4. Listed the files of all 102 published airflow packages in the DHI Debian repository, 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-10 (51 builds, amd64 and arm64), each verified against the checksum in the package index, and searched every bundled .whl, .zip and .egg archive for a tornado package; both architectures agree for every build. Builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-0 contain no Tornado: there is no tornado dist-info, no tornado package directory and no archive holding one. Builds 3.4.0-1 to 3.4.0-10 ship one copy of Tornado, under /usr/lib/airflow/lib/python3.13/site-packages, and its dist-info and tornado/__init__.py both give version 6.6. In the 3.4.0-10 amd64 package, tornado/web.py still derives the expected scheme and netloc from the formatted template and lacks the slash-collapsing and invalid-character checks the fix commit adds. No published build ships 6.6.1 or later, so the affected range starts at 3.4.0-1, the first build that ships Tornado, and has no fixed version yet.
